d: Bihar ki rajdhani patna ke shastri nagar thana kshetr sthit eji koloni men bihar sarkar ke uchch shiksha mantri sanjay taigar ke niji aavas (makan nanbar B-20) men chori ki bari vardat samne aaee hai. 14 aur 15 navanbar ki darmiyani rat agyat choron ne band ghar ko nishana banate hue lakhon rupye ke jevrat aur nakdi par hath saph kar diya.
